# ULTRAMETRICA

> Zero-dependency real-time $p$-adic AdS/CFT holographic quantum gravity, rotating Tate-curve Kerr-BTZ black hole, Kozyrev wavelet, 48 kHz AudioWorklet, and pure Lean 4.35.0 formal verification laboratory (120 kernel-audited declarations, verified across 6 independent Lean kernels via `lake comparator --paranoid`).

- Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`)
- Version: `1.4.0`
- Repository: https://github.com/0thernes/ultrametrica
- Live Observatory: https://0thernes.github.io/ultrametrica/
- License: `COSMOGONIC LICENSE — NON-COMMERCIAL RESEARCH & PLAY` ([`LICENSE`](LICENSE))
